name: pipseq
description: Fluent BioSciences PIPseq single-cell RNA data requiring PIPseeker-compatible chemistry-specific processing.
notes: UniScFlow recognizes explicit sample-level PIPseq wet-lab metadata and intentionally halts after download rather than substituting generic 10x or STARsolo barcode settings.

halt_guidance.blocker: PIPseq barcode and UMI processing depend on the matching Fluent BioSciences kit generation and PIPseeker configuration; generic droplet settings are not a validated substitute.
required_inputs: PIPseq kit and capacity/version, such as T2, T10, or T20, with the matching PIPseeker release
next_steps: Confirm the PIPseq capture kit and chemistry version from the sample protocol or methods.
Run the downloaded FASTQs with the matching PIPseeker chemistry and reference configuration.
Archive the PIPseeker command and configuration, then validate the resulting gene-by-cell matrix before resuming downstream analysis.

recommended_workflows.name: PIPseeker
recommended_workflows.role: Fluent BioSciences-supported PIPseq barcode processing, alignment, and quantification

halt_guidance.resume: Use the validated PIPseeker matrix downstream; UniScFlow does not replace PIPseq chemistry-specific barcode processing with generic STARsolo settings.
